AI.result: 原始 CSD 余弦在成对层面有 23/91 艺术家出现负的判别差距（稳健仅 2/91），在聚合池风格评估中有 15/91；CSD+（CSLS + 位置插值）将无监督成对验证 AUC 从 0.883 提升到 0.905；跨 backbone 实验显示该问题具有普遍性。
AI.conclusion: 报告 CSD 余弦作为绝对风格 fidelity 分数前应先运行判别差距诊断；CSLS 是最小修正方案，建议采用 CSD+ 协议。

title: Don't Click That: Teaching Web Agents to Resist Deceptive Interfaces
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference. 23 pages, 8 figures, 19 tables
summary: Vision-language model (VLM) based web agents demonstrate impressive autonomous GUI interaction but remain vulnerable to deceptive interface elements. Existing approaches either detect deception without task integration or document attacks without proposing defenses. We formalize deception-aware web agent defense and propose DUDE (Deceptive UI Detector & Evaluator), a two-stage framework combining hybrid-reward learning with asymmetric penalties and experience summarization to distill failure patterns into transferable guidance. We introduce RUC (Real UI Clickboxes), a benchmark of 1,407 scenarios spanning four domains and deception categories. Experiments show DUDE reduces deception susceptibility by 53.8% while maintaining task performance, establishing an effective foundation for robust web agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出DUDE框架，通过混合奖励学习、非对称惩罚和经验总结，将VLM网页代理对欺骗性界面的敏感性降低53.8%，同时保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM网页代理容易受到欺骗性界面元素的影响，而现有方法要么只检测欺骗而不集成任务，要么只记录攻击而不提出防御措施。
AI.method: 提出DUDE（Deceptive UI Detector & Evaluator）两阶段框架，结合混合奖励学习与非对称惩罚，以及经验总结技术，将失败模式提炼为可迁移的指导。
AI.result: 在包含1,407个场景的RUC基准测试上，DUDE将欺骗敏感性降低53.8%，同时保持任务性能不受影响。
AI.conclusion: DUDE为鲁棒的网页代理部署建立了有效基础，证明了欺骗感知防御在实际场景中的可行性。

title: Annotations Mitigate Post-Training Mode Collapse
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
summary: Post-training (via supervised fine-tuning) improves instruction-following, but often induces semantic mode collapse by biasing models toward low-entropy fine-tuning data at the expense of the high-entropy pretraining distribution. Crucially, we find this trade-off worsens with scale. To close this semantic diversity gap, we propose annotation-anchored training, a principled method that enables models to adopt the preference-following behaviors of post-training without sacrificing the inherent diversity of pretraining. Our approach is simple: we pretrain on documents paired with semantic annotations, inducing a rich annotation distribution that reflects the full breadth of pretraining data, and we preserve this distribution during post-training. This lets us sample diverse annotations at inference time and use them as anchors to guide generation, effectively transferring pretraining's semantic richness into post-trained models. We find that models trained with annotation-anchored training can attain $6 \times$ less diversity collapse than models trained with SFT, and improve with scale.

AI.tldr: 提出标注锚定训练方法，通过在预训练时引入语义标注分布，并在后训练中保持该分布，从而解决后训练导致的语义模式坍塌问题，使模型在保持指令跟随能力的同时不损失预训练的语义多样性。
AI.motivation: 后训练（监督微调）虽然提升了指令跟随能力，但会导致语义模式坍塌——模型偏向低熵的微调数据而丧失预训练的高熵分布，且该问题随模型规模扩大而恶化。
AI.method: 提出标注锚定训练：在预训练阶段为文档配对语义标注，构建丰富的标注分布；在后训练阶段保留该分布；推理时采样多样标注作为锚点引导生成。
AI.result: 相比标准SFT，标注锚定训练的模型多样性坍塌减少了6倍，且随规模扩大效果更好。
AI.conclusion: 标注锚定训练是一种简单而有效的原则性方法，能够在不牺牲预训练语义多样性的前提下赋予模型后训练的偏好跟随能力。

title: SeasonScapes: Learning Large-scale Re-lightable 3D Landscapes with Seasonal Variation from Sparse Webcams
summary: We introduce SeasonScapes framework and a the SeasonScapes dataset: Swiss Sparse-view Mountain Scenes with Seasonal Changes that covers over 50 km x 60 km, composed of more than 85,000 webcam images captured from 32 different locations across 13 timestamps throughout a full year. By projecting these timestamp-specific images onto a 3D mesh, we construct seasonal 3D landscapes that reflect natural appearance changes over time. To address occlusions and missing data, we leverage conditional diffusion models for image-guided inpainting directly on the mesh. The resulting completed meshes can be further relighted using standard physically-based renderer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SeasonScapes框架和数据集，包含覆盖50x60公里、来自32个地点全年13个时间戳的85,000+张网络摄像头图像，通过将图像投影到3D网格并利用条件扩散模型进行修复，构建了反映季节变化的3D景观。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景数据集缺乏时间维度上的自然变化（如季节更替），无法捕捉真实世界景观随时间演变的动态外观。
AI.method: 1) 收集32个地点全年13个时间戳的85,000+张网络摄像头图像；2) 将时间戳图像投影到3D网格构建季节性3D景观；3) 使用条件扩散模型进行图像引导的网格修复以处理遮挡和缺失数据；4) 支持标准物理渲染器重新照明。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖50km×60km的大规模季节性3D场景数据集，成功实现了反映自然外观随时间变化的3D景观重建与修复。
AI.conclusion: SeasonScapes有效解决了大规模户外场景中因季节变化导致的外观建模问题，为3D视觉和时间动态场景理解提供了新资源和方法。

title: WindINR: Latent-State INR for Fast Local Wind Query and Correction in Complex Terrain
summary: Many downstream decisions in complex terrain require fast wind estimates at a small number of user-specified locations and heights for a given forecast valid time, rather than another dense forecast field on a fixed grid. We present WindINR, a latent-state implicit neural representation framework for continuous high-resolution local wind query and sparse-observation correction. WindINR maps static terrain descriptors, a low-resolution background field, and continuous query coordinates to a high-resolution wind state through a latent-conditioned decoder. To enable rapid inference-time correction, WindINR separates reusable representation learning from sample-specific latent-state correction. During training, a privileged encoder infers a reference latent state from high-resolution supervision, a deployable latent predictor estimates an initial latent state from inference-time inputs alone, and their discrepancies are summarized into a dataset-adaptive Gaussian prior over latent corrections. At inference time, within the WindINR module, network weights remain fixed and only the latent state is updated by minimizing a regularized correction objective using sparse observations and their uncertainty. In controlled OSSEs over the Senja region, including a UAV-aided approach scenario and random-observation robustness tests, WindINR improves local high-resolution wind estimates by updating only a compact latent state rather than the full network. The corrected representation remains continuously queryable at arbitrary coordinates and, in our CPU benchmark, yields about a $2.6\times$ online-correction speedup over full-network fine-tuning, suggesting a practical interface between kilometer-scale background products, sparse local observations, and wind queries in complex terrain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WindINR，一种隐式神经表征框架，用于复杂地形下的连续高分辨率局部风速查询与稀疏观测校正。它通过可分离的潜在状态学习与校正机制，在推理时仅更新少量潜在变量而非整个网络，实现高效的风场估计，在Senja地区的OSS实验中展现出约2.6倍的在线校正加速比。
AI.motivation: 复杂地形下的许多下游决策需要在给定预报有效时间内，对用户指定的少量位置和高度进行快速风速估计，而非获取固定网格上的稠密预报场。现有方法难以同时满足高分辨率局部查询与稀疏观测实时校正的需求。
AI.method: WindINR框架包含：1）将静态地形描述符、低分辨率背景场和连续查询坐标映射到高分辨率风速的潜在条件解码器；2）训练阶段通过特权编码器从高分辨率监督中推断参考潜在状态，可部署的潜在预测器从推理时输入估计初始状态，并建立潜在校正的高斯先验；3）推理时仅更新潜在状态（网络权重固定），通过正则化校正目标利用稀疏观测及其不确定性进行优化。
AI.result: 在Senja地区的控制OSS实验中，包括无人机辅助场景和随机观测鲁棒性测试，WindINR通过仅更新紧凑的潜在状态提升了局部高分辨率风速估计质量。在CPU基准测试中，相比全网络微调，实现了约2.6倍的在线校正速度提升。
AI.conclusion: WindINR提出了一种实用的接口，连接公里级背景产品、稀疏局部观测与复杂地形下的风速查询，兼顾了高分辨率查询的连续性与推理时的高效校正。

title: Dependency-Aware Discrete Diffusion for Scene Graph Generation
summary: Scene graphs (SGs) represent objects and their relationships as structured graphs, enabling applications in image generation, robotics, and 3D understanding. Recent work suggests that conditioning image generation on scene graphs improves compositional fidelity compared to text-only prompting. However, since users typically provide text rather than structured graphs, a key challenge is to generate scene graphs from natural language. Prior work on discrete diffusion has demonstrated success in generating generic graphs such as molecules and circuits, but fails to account for the hierarchical structure and strong dependencies between objects, edges, and relations in scene graphs. We address this limitation by introducing a dependency-aware, hierarchically constrained discrete diffusion model for scene graph generation. Our approach decouples structure and semantics across the forward and reverse processes, enabling the model to capture conditional dependencies. At inference time, we perform training-free conditioning to sample text-aligned scene graphs. We evaluate our method on standard SG benchmarks and demonstrate improvements over both continuous and discrete graph generation baselines across graph and layout metrics. When fed to downstream image generation, our approach yields improved compositional alignment compared to text-to-image models, particularly in multi-object scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种依赖感知、层次约束的离散扩散模型，用于从自然语言生成场景图，并在下游图像生成中提升了组合对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以从自然语言生成场景图，因为场景图具有层次结构和对象-边-关系之间的强依赖关系，而通用的离散扩散模型无法捕捉这些结构化依赖。
AI.method: 提出依赖感知的层次约束离散扩散模型，在前向和反向过程中解耦结构与语义，以捕捉条件依赖关系；推理时通过无训练条件化采样文本对齐的场景图。
AI.result: 在场景图和布局指标上优于连续和离散图生成基线；在下游图像生成中，特别是在多对象场景下，组合对齐能力优于文本到图像模型。
AI.conclusion: 层次约束的离散扩散模型能有效从文本生成高质量场景图，进而提升图像生成的组合忠实度。

title: A Game Theoretic Free Energy Analysis of Higher Order Synergy in Attention Heads of Large Language Models
comment: this manuscript has been submitted to Neural Networks
summary: Large language models rely on multihead attention, but interactions among heads remain poorly understood. We apply the Game Theoretic Free Energy Principle (GTFEP): a framework casting multiagent systems as distributed variational inference to analyze attention heads as bounded rational agents. According to GTFEP, each head minimizes its variational free energy, and collective behavior follows a Gibbs distribution over coalition structures whose energy is decomposed into Harsanyi dividends. Using a tractable approximation (uniform prior, deterministic dynamics), coalition free energy reduces to joint Shannon entropy of discretized head outputs (argmax key index). Pairwise dividends become mutual information (nonnegative), while triple dividends correspond to interaction information and can be negative. On BERT, GPT2, and Llama with GSM8K, triple dividends are consistently negative, revealing higher order redundancy. The Nash FEP correspondence guarantees that stationary points of collective free energy are epsilon Nash equilibria; thus, heads with negligible contribution can be pruned with minimal performance loss. Pruning heads with low marginal contribution reduces computational cost with minimal performance loss: for example, pruning 20% of heads in GPT2 reduces FLOPs by 18%, increases throughput by 22%, and raises perplexity only modestly (from 28.4 to 33.4 on GSM8K). Our work shows GTFEP provides a principled foundation for analyzing and optimizing transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出博弈论自由能原理（GTFEP）分析Transformer多头注意力机制，将注意力头视为有限理性智能体，通过变分推断建模其交互。关键发现：三元交互信息（三重股息）一致为负，揭示高阶冗余；基于边际贡献剪枝可在最小性能损失下降低计算成本（如GPT2剪枝20%头部，FLOPs降低18%，吞吐量提升22%）。
AI.motivation: 多头注意力中头部间的交互机制尚不明确，缺乏统一的数学框架来理解和优化这些交互。
AI.method: 应用博弈论自由能原理（GTFEP），将注意力头建模为有限理性智能体，每个头最小化其变分自由能，集体行为遵循联盟结构的吉布斯分布。通过均匀先验和确定性动力学近似，将联盟自由能简化为离散化头部输出的联合香农熵，将Harsanyi股息分解为互信息和交互信息。
AI.result: 在BERT、GPT2和Llama上，三重股息一致为负（高阶冗余）；剪枝低边际贡献的头部可在最小性能损失下大幅降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: GTFEP为分析和优化Transformer架构提供了理论基础，验证了基于博弈论信息论的剪枝策略的有效性。

title: PlantMarkerBench: A Multi-Species Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Plant Marker Reasoning
summary: Cell-type-specific marker genes are fundamental to plant biology, yet existing resources primarily rely on curated databases or high-throughput studies without explicitly modeling the supporting evidence found in scientific literature. We introduce PlantMarkerBench, a multi-species benchmark for evaluating literature-grounded plant marker evidence interpretation from full-text biological papers. PlantMarkerBench is constructed using a modular curation pipeline integrating large-scale literature retrieval, hybrid search, species-aware biological grounding, structured evidence extraction, and targeted human review. The benchmark spans four plant species -- Arabidopsis, maize, rice, and tomato -- and contains 5,550 sentence-level evidence instances annotated for marker-evidence validity, evidence type, and support strength. We define two benchmark tasks: determining whether a candidate sentence provides valid marker evidence for a gene-cell-type pair, and classifying the evidence into expression, localization, function, indirect, or negative categories. We benchmark diverse open-weight and closed-source language models across species and prompting strategies. Although frontier models achieve relatively strong performance on direct expression evidence, performance drops substantially on functional, indirect, and weak-support evidence, with evidence-type confusion emerging as a dominant failure mode. Open-weight models additionally exhibit elevated false-positive rates under ambiguous biological contexts. PlantMarkerBench provides a challenging and reproducible evaluation framework for literature-grounded biological evidence attribution and supports future research on trustworthy scientific information extraction and AI-assisted plant biology.

AI.tldr: PlantMarkerBench是一个多物种基准测试集，用于评估从文献中提取植物细胞类型特异性标记基因证据的能力，包含5550个句子级标注实例和两个评估任务。
AI.motivation: 现有植物标记基因资源主要依赖人工数据库或高通量研究，缺乏对文献中支持证据的系统建模，因此需要建立可评估文献证据解释能力的基准。
AI.method: 采用模块化策展流程，整合大规模文献检索、混合搜索、物种感知的生物学基础构建、结构化证据提取和人工审核，构建包含4种植物、5550个证据实例的基准，定义了两个评估任务并测试了多种大语言模型。
AI.result: 前沿模型在直接表达证据上表现较好，但在功能、间接和弱支持证据上性能大幅下降；证据类型混淆是主要失败模式；开源模型在模糊生物学背景下假阳性率较高。
AI.conclusion: PlantMarkerBench为文献基础的生物证据归因提供了可复现的评估框架，支持可信科学信息提取和AI辅助植物生物学研究。

title: Reducing Annotation Burden for Femoral Cartilage Segmentation in Knee MRI via Cross-Sequence Transfer Learning
summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate cross-sequence transfer learning for automatic femoral cartilage segmentation, testing bidirectional transfer between dual-echo steady-state (DESS) and sagittal proton density-weighted 3D fast spin-echo (Cube) sequences. Materials and Methods: We optimized a modified 2D U-Net on 507 DESS images from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI). We then established same-sequence baselines using subject-level cross-validation on a subset of 44 OAI DESS images and 44 Cube images acquired at the Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Bologna, Italy. Each subset included 22 non-lesioned and 22 lesioned subjects. Finally, we performed transfer learning across sequences by fine-tuning the pretrained models on the target sequence with increasing training set sizes to study convergence, while keeping validation and test sets fixed. Segmentations were evaluated using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and average surface distance (ASD). Lesion effects were assessed with two-sided Mann-Whitney U tests with Bonferroni correction. Results: Same-sequence training yielded higher accuracy on DESS than Cube (DSC, $0.900$ vs $0.830$; $P < .001$). Cube-to-DESS transfer matched DESS performance (DSC, $0.903 \pm 0.032$ vs $0.900 \pm 0.027$), reaching a performance plateau at 9 training subjects. DESS-to-Cube yielded a lower combined DSC ($0.802 \pm 0.049$ vs $0.830 \pm 0.042$), reaching a plateau at 24 training subjects. Lesions did not affect DESS ($P \ge .39$) but reduced Cube accuracy (DSC, $0.805$ vs $0.856$; $P < .001$). Conclusion: Transfer learning across sequences can substantially reduce target-sequence annotation requirements for femoral cartilage segmentation, but performance is direction- and sequence-dependent, and the effects of lesions on segmentation may vary across MRI sequences.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并评估了用于股骨软骨自动分割的跨序列迁移学习，在DESS和Cube两种MRI序列之间进行了双向迁移测试。结果表明Cube→DESS迁移性能与同序列训练相当（DSC 0.903 vs 0.900），而DESS→Cube迁移效果较差（DSC 0.802 vs 0.830），且病灶对Cube序列分割精度有显著负面影响。
AI.motivation: 为了减少在目标MRI序列上进行股骨软骨分割时所需的大量标注数据，探索利用已有标注的源序列模型通过迁移学习降低目标序列的标注需求。
AI.method: 在507张DESS图像上优化修改的2D U-Net，建立同序列基线（各44张DESS和Cube图像），然后进行跨序列微调，逐步增大训练集规模研究收敛性，使用DSC和ASD评估分割效果。
AI.result: 同序列训练DESS优于Cube（DSC 0.900 vs 0.830，P<.001）。Cube→DESS迁移达到DSC 0.903，9个训练样本即达平台期；DESS→Cube迁移仅DSC 0.802，需24个样本达平台期。病灶不影响DESS（P≥.39）但降低Cube精度（DSC 0.805 vs 0.856，P<.001）。
AI.conclusion: 跨序列迁移学习可显著减少目标序列的标注需求，但性能具有方向性和序列依赖性，且病灶对不同MRI序列分割的影响存在差异。

title: Weighted Rules under the Stable Model Semantics
summary: We introduce the concept of weighted rules under the stable model semantics following the log-linear models of Markov Logic. This provides versatile methods to overcome the deterministic nature of the stable model semantics, such as resolving inconsistencies in answer set programs, ranking stable models, associating probability to stable models, and applying statistical inference to computing weighted stable models. We also present formal comparisons with related formalisms, such as answer set programs, Markov Logic, ProbLog, and P-log.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了加权规则的概念，在稳定模型语义下结合马尔可夫逻辑的log-linear模型，以克服稳定模型语义的确定性限制，并比较了相关形式化方法。
AI.motivation: 稳定模型语义具有确定性，无法处理不一致性、模型排序、概率关联和统计推理等问题，因此需要引入加权规则来增强表达能力。
AI.method: 借鉴马尔可夫逻辑中的log-linear模型，将加权规则引入稳定模型语义框架下，实现概率化扩展。
AI.result: 提出加权规则方法，能够解决回答集程序中的不一致性、对稳定模型进行排序、为稳定模型关联概率，并应用统计推理计算加权稳定模型。
AI.conclusion: 加权规则有效扩展了稳定模型语义，并与回答集程序、马尔可夫逻辑、ProbLog和P-log等形式化方法进行了形式化比较。

title: Personalizing LLMs with Binary Feedback: A Preference-Corrected Optimization Framework
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) personalization aims to align model behaviors with individual user preferences. Existing methods often focus on isolated user histories, neglecting the essential role of inter-user differences. We propose C-BPO, a framework that personalizes LLMs via preference-calibrated binary signals. By treating target user data as positive feedback and other users' data as an auxiliary set of implicit negative signals, C-BPO captures distinct inter-user differences. To mitigate the preference overlap issue, where shared task knowledge is erroneously penalized, we derive an objective grounded in Positive-Unlabeled (PU) learning theory. This approach purifies negative signals by subtracting ``positive bias'', ensuring alignment with unique idiosyncrasies without compromising general helpfulness. Empirical experiments across various personalization tasks and backbone LLMs show C-BPO consistently outperforms baselines, demonstrating the efficacy of preference-calibrated binary signals in modeling inter-user differences.

AI.tldr: C-BPO通过偏好校准的二元信号（将目标用户数据作为正反馈，其他用户数据作为隐式负信号），结合正-未标注（PU）学习理论来消除偏好重叠问题，从而在保持通用帮助性的同时实现LLM个性化对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法过度关注孤立用户历史，忽视了用户间差异的关键作用，导致个性化效果受限。
AI.method: 提出C-BPO框架：1) 将目标用户数据视为正反馈，其他用户数据视为隐式负信号以捕获用户间差异；2) 基于正-未标注（PU）学习理论设计目标函数，通过减去"正偏置"来净化负信号，解决偏好重叠问题。
AI.result: 在各种个性化任务和多种基础LLM上，C-BPO一致优于基线方法，验证了偏好校准二元信号在建模用户间差异方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: C-BPO通过偏好校准的二元信号有效建模用户间差异，在保证通用帮助性的前提下实现了个性化对齐，是LLM个性化领域的一个有效框架。

title: Probability-Flow Distillation: Exact Wasserstein Gradient Flow for High-Fidelity 3D Generation
summary: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) and its variants have been widely used for text-to-3D generation by distilling 2D image diffusion priors. However, the standard SDS objective is prone to severe mode collapse, frequently yielding over-smoothed and over-saturated results. Although recent advancements, such as Score Distillation via Inversion (SDI), mitigate these artifacts and produce visually sharper models, they ultimately fail to faithfully capture the full target distribution. In this work, we show that the bottleneck limiting the sampling capacity of SDI stems from its reliance on the posterior mean estimator, which is mathematically equivalent to a single-step Euler approximation of the deterministic reverse DDIM trajectory. To address this, we propose a naturally motivated extension termed Probability-Flow Distillation (PFD). We establish that PFD corresponds exactly to a Wasserstein gradient flow, thereby inducing principled distribution-matching dynamics. Finally, we show that PFD can synthesize 3D assets with fine-grained, high-fidelity details and achieve improved quality compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率流蒸馏（PFD）方法，通过将蒸馏目标与Wasserstein梯度流对应，解决了SDS和SDI方法中的模式坍塌问题，实现了更高质量、更精细的文本到3D生成。
AI.motivation: 标准SDS方法容易出现模式坍塌，产生过平滑和过饱和的结果；而SDI方法虽然能生成视觉上更锐利的模型，但无法准确捕捉完整的目标分布，其瓶颈在于依赖后验均值估计器（等价于确定性反向DDIM轨迹的单步欧拉近似）。
AI.method: 提出概率流蒸馏（PFD）方法，将其建立为Wasserstein梯度流，从而引入原则性的分布匹配动力学机制，替代SDI中受限的后验均值估计器。
AI.result: PFD能够合成具有细粒度、高保真细节的3D资产，在生成质量上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PFD通过分布匹配动力学有效解决了模式坍塌问题，为文本到3D生成提供了更优的蒸馏框架。

title: Functional Stable Model Semantics and Answer Set Programming Modulo Theories
summary: Recently there has been an increasing interest in incorporating ``intensional'' functions in answer set programming. Intensional functions are those whose values can be described by other functions and predicates, rather than being pre-defined as in the standard answer set programming. We demonstrate that the functional stable model semantics plays an important role in the framework of ``Answer Set Programming Modulo Theories (ASPMT)'' -- a tight integration of answer set programming and satisfiability modulo theories, under which existing integration approaches can be viewed as special cases where the role of functions is limited. We show that ``tight'' ASPMT programs can be translated into SMT instances, which is similar to the known relationship between ASP and SAT.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了内涵函数在回答集编程中的重要性，展示了功能稳定模型语义在ASPMT框架中的关键作用，并将紧ASPMT程序转化为SMT实例。
AI.motivation: 随着对回答集编程中内涵函数兴趣的增加，现有方法对函数的角色有限，需要更统一的框架来整合ASP和SMT。
AI.method: 通过展示功能稳定模型语义在ASPMT框架中的作用，将紧ASPMT程序转化为SMT实例。
AI.result: 证明了紧ASPMT程序可以转化为SMT实例，类似于ASP与SAT之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 功能稳定模型语义是ASPMT框架的核心，现有整合方法可视为其特例，且紧ASPMT到SMT的转化为统一框架提供了理论基础。

title: Swarm Skills: A Portable, Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System Specification for Coordination Engineering
summary: As artificial intelligence engineering paradigms shift from single-agent Prompt and Context Engineering toward multi-agent \textbf{Coordination Engineering}, the ability to codify and systematically improve how multiple agents collaborate has emerged as a critical bottleneck. While single-agent skills can now be distributed as portable assets, multi-agent coordination protocols remain locked within framework-internal code or static configurations, preventing them from being shared across systems or autonomously improved over time. We propose \textbf{Swarm Skills}, a portable specification that extends the Anthropic Skills standard with multi-agent semantics. Swarm Skills turns multi-agent workflows into first-class, distributable assets that consist of roles, workflows, execution bounds, and a built-in semantic structure for self-evolution. To operationalize the specification's evolving nature, we present a companion self-evolution algorithm that automatically distills successful execution trajectories into new Swarm Skills and continuously patches existing ones based on multi-dimensional scoring (Effectiveness, Utilization, and Freshness), eliminating the need for human-in-the-loop oversight during the refinement process. Through an architectural compatibility analysis and a comprehensive qualitative case study using the open-source JiuwenSwarm reference implementation, we demonstrate how Swarm Skills achieves zero-adapter cross-agent portability via progressive disclosure, enabling agent teams to self-evolve their coordination strategies without framework lock-in.

AI.tldr: 提出Swarm Skills规范，将多智能体协调协议转化为可移植、可自演化的资产，通过自演化算法实现跨框架零适配器移植。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协调协议被锁定在框架内部代码或静态配置中，无法跨系统共享或随时间自主改进，成为AI工程从单智能体Prompt Engineering向多智能体Coordination Engineering转变的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 提出Swarm Skills规范，扩展Anthropic Skills标准，加入角色、工作流、执行边界和语义结构。2. 设计自演化算法，自动提取成功执行轨迹形成新Swarm Skills，并基于多维度评分（有效性、利用率、新鲜度）持续修补现有技能。
AI.result: 通过架构兼容性分析和基于JiuwenSwarm开源实现的定性案例研究，证明Swarm Skills通过渐进式披露实现了零适配器跨智能体可移植性。
AI.conclusion: Swarm Skills使智能体团队能够自演化协调策略而无需框架锁定，无需人工参与优化过程。

title: Cplus2ASP: Computing Action Language C+ in Answer Set Programming
summary: We present Version 2 of system Cplus2ASP, which implements the definite fragment of action language C+. Its input language is fully compatible with the language of the Causal Calculator Version 2, but the new system is significantly faster thanks to modern answer set solving techniques. The translation implemented in the system is a composition of several recent theoretical results. The system orchestrates a tool chain, consisting of f2lp, clingo, iclingo, and as2transition. Under the incremental execution mode, the system translates a C+ description into the input language of iclingo, exploiting its incremental grounding mechanism. The correctness of this execution is justified by the module theorem extended to programs with nested expressions. In addition, the input language of the system has many useful features, such as external atoms by means of Lua calls and the user interactive mode. The system supports extensible multi-modal translations for other action languages, such as B and BC, as well.

AI.tldr: Cplus2ASP Version 2 是一个基于回答集编程的C+动作语言求解器，通过整合f2lp、clingo、iclingo等工具链，显著提升了推理速度，并支持增量执行、外部原子调用和多种动作语言翻译。
AI.motivation: Cplus2ASP V1虽然能处理C+动作语言，但性能不足。V2旨在利用现代回答集求解技术，显著提高推理效率。
AI.method: 系统采用工具链架构（f2lp, clingo, iclingo, as2transition），将C+描述编译为iclingo的输入语言，利用增量接地机制；翻译过程基于若干最新理论结果的组合，并通过模块定理保证正确性。
AI.result: 新版系统在兼容原Causal Calculator 2语言的基础上，推理速度显著提升，支持增量执行模式、Lua外部原子调用、用户交互模式，以及扩展的多模态翻译（如B和BC动作语言）。
AI.conclusion: Cplus2ASP V2通过现代ASP技术大幅提升了C+动作语言推理的性能，同时保持了语言兼容性，并提供了丰富的扩展功能，为动作推理研究提供了高效工具。

title: Not-So-Strange Love: Language Models and Generative Linguistic Theories are More Compatible than They Appear
comment: Accepted to Behavioral and Brain Sciences; 4 pages; Commentary on "How Linguistics Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Language Models" by Richard Futrell and Kyle Mahowald
summary: Futrell and Mahowald (2025) frame the success of neural language models (LMs) as supporting gradient, usage-based linguistic theories. I argue that LMs can also instantiate theories based on formal structures - the types of theories seen in the generative tradition. This argument expands the space of theories that can be tested with LMs, potentially enabling reconciliations between usage-based and generative accounts.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了神经语言模型仅支持基于使用/渐变语言理论的观点，论证了它们同样能实例化基于形式结构的生成语言学理论，为两类理论的和解提供了可能。
AI.motivation: Futrell和Mahowald（2025）认为神经语言模型的成功支持基于使用/渐变的语言学理论。作者试图反驳这一观点，论证语言模型同样可以实例化基于形式结构的理论（即生成语言学传统中的理论），从而拓展了可用语言模型进行检验的理论空间。
AI.method: 通过理论论证和逻辑分析，反驳Futrell和Mahowald（2025）的立场，提出神经语言模型能够实例化形式结构理论的观点。
AI.result: 论证了神经语言模型可以同时支持基于使用和基于形式的语言学理论，扩展了可检验的理论范围。
AI.conclusion: 神经语言模型不仅支持基于使用的语言学理论，也能实例化形式结构理论，这为调和基于使用和生成语言学两大传统提供了可能性。

title: Investigating Anisotropy in Visual Grounding under Controlled Counterfactual Perturbations
comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 5th Explainable AI for Computer Vision (XAI4CV) Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary:
Visual Grounding benchmarks assume that the object described by a referring expression is always present in the image, and grounding models are therefore rarely evaluated under semantically mismatched captions. In such cases, models frequently exhibit approximation behavior, producing a plausible bounding box that satisfies only part of the expression (\eg, preserving the original object while ignoring modified contextual cues). Because mismatched captions represent realistic edge cases, this behavior compromises reliability and raises concerns from an explainability perspective. Identifying its underlying causes is thus essential for improving model faithfulness and interpretability.
  Adopting a mechanistic interpretability viewpoint, this work examines whether embedding anisotropy contributes to counterfactual failures. A similarity-controlled counterfactual caption generation protocol is introduced to systematically perturb object or contextual components within predefined embedding similarity intervals, enabling a fine-grained analysis of grounding behavior as a function of alignment. Experiments on two Transformer-based models with markedly different embedding geometries (BERT-based TransVG and CLIP-based SwimVG) reveal no meaningful correlation between cosine similarity and approximation. These findings suggest that anisotropy alone does not account for counterfactual errors, and that robustness requires investigating finer-grained geometric properties of the embedding space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉定位模型在语义不匹配描述下的近似行为，发现嵌入各向异性并非导致模型错误的主要因素，鲁棒性需要更细粒度的嵌入空间几何特性分析。
AI.motivation: 视觉定位模型在面对语义不匹配的描述时会产生近似行为（忽略上下文变化，只满足部分条件），这影响模型可靠性和可解释性。现有基准很少评估此类场景，因此需要探究其根本原因。
AI.method: 采用机械可解释性视角，提出基于相似度控制的对抗性描述生成协议，系统性地扰动物体或上下文成分，在预定义的嵌入相似度区间内分析定位行为。在BERT-based TransVG和CLIP-based SwimVG两个模型上实验。
AI.result: 余弦相似度与模型近似行为之间不存在有意义的关联，嵌入各向异性并不能解释反事实错误。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入各向异性不足以解释模型的反事实定位失败，需要进一步研究嵌入空间中更细粒度的几何特性来提升模型鲁棒性。

title: LLM-Guided Monte Carlo Tree Search over Knowledge Graphs: Composing Mechanistic Explanations for Drug-Disease Pairs
comment: Accepted at IJCAI-ECAI 2026. 9 pages (7 content + 2 references), 5 figures, 3 tables. Includes supplementary material (26 pages)
summary: Extracting multi-step explanations from knowledge graphs poses a combinatorial challenge requiring both heuristic guidance (as candidates proliferate with depth) and credit assignment (as path quality emerges over extended sequences). Frontier LLMs, strong on knowledge/reasoning benchmarks, offer a compelling source of such heuristics, yet their knowledge comes sans guarantees and compositional performance degrades as chains lengthen. We thus present TESSERA, a 3-part neuro-symbolic framework that uses LLMs in a circumscribed role: for local discriminative judgement rather than autonomous multi-step generation; the knowledge graph then defines the hypothesis space enforcing hard structural constraints, and MCTS coordinates the long-horizon search with principled credit assignment via backpropagation. LLMs perform dual roles as a prior policy biasing exploration and a comparative state evaluator supplying reward signals. Evaluation on drug mechanism elucidation across two complementary knowledge graphs demonstrates fidelity to curated biology while surfacing coherent alternative mechanisms, with ablations confirming discriminative contribution from both LLM components. Beyond its current application, our framework offers a general paradigm for compositional reasoning over structured knowledge.

AI.tldr: TESSERA是一个基于LLM与知识图谱的神经符号框架，通过MCTS进行长程组合推理，用于从知识图谱中提取多步解释。
AI.motivation: 从知识图谱中提取多步解释面临组合爆炸（随深度增加候选路径激增）和信用分配（路径质量需长序列评估）两大挑战。前沿LLM虽强但知识无保证且长链组合性能下降，因此需要一种约束性更强的方法。
AI.method: 提出TESSERA框架，包含三个部分：(1) LLM扮演双重角色——作为先验策略引导探索，作为比较状态评估器提供奖励信号；(2) 知识图谱定义假设空间并施加硬结构约束；(3) MCTS协调长程搜索，通过反向传播进行原则性的信用分配。LLM仅用于局部判别判断，而非自主多步生成。
AI.result: 在药物机制阐释任务上，在两个互补的知识图谱上评估，结果显示该方法既能忠实于已有的生物学知识，又能发现一致的可选机制。消融实验证实了两个LLM组件（先验策略和评估器）的判别性贡献。
AI.conclusion: TESSERA为结构化知识上的组合推理提供了一种通用范式，超越了当前药物机制阐释的应用场景。

title: NCO: A Versatile Plug-in for Handling Negative Constraints in Decoding
summary: Controlling Large Language Models (LLMs) to prevent the generation of undesirable content, such as profanity and personally identifiable information (PII), has become increasingly critical. While earlier approaches relied on post-processing or resampling, recent research has shifted towards constrained decoding methods that control outputs during generation to mitigate high computational costs and quality degradation. However, preventing multiple forbidden hard constraints or regex constraints from appearing anywhere in the output is computationally challenging. A straightforward solution is to convert these constraints into a single automaton that tracks all forbidden patterns during decoding, but this often becomes impractically large. Standard regex engines also do not readily support the operations needed to build such a constraint, such as complement and intersection. In order to address these limitations, we propose NCO, a decoding strategy that performs online pattern matching over finite hard constraints and regex constraints, reducing computational overhead without inducing state explosion. NCO is fully compatible with standard inference strategies, including various sampling methods and beam search, while also supporting soft masking for probabilistic suppression. We empirically demonstrate its effectiveness across practical tasks, including PII and profanity suppression. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/hyundong98/NCO-Decoding.git .

AI.tldr: 提出NCO解码策略，通过在线模式匹配高效控制LLM输出中的硬约束和正则约束，避免状态爆炸问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在同时防止多个禁止性硬约束或正则约束出现在输出中时，计算成本高且容易导致自动机状态爆炸，标准正则引擎也不支持补集和交集等必要操作。
AI.method: NCO解码策略：采用在线模式匹配技术处理有限硬约束和正则约束，减少计算开销且不引发状态爆炸，兼容多种采样方法和束搜索，支持软掩码进行概率抑制。
AI.result: 在PII和脏话抑制等实际任务上验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: NCO提供了一种高效、兼容性强且可扩展的约束解码方案，能够在不牺牲生成质量的前提下有效控制LLM输出中的禁止内容。

title: TIDE-Bench: Task-Aware and Diagnostic Evaluation of Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-integrated reasoning has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing large language models with external computation, retrieval, and execution capabilities. However, the field still lacks a high-quality and unified evaluation benchmark, and existing TIR evaluations remain limited in dataset quality, task diversity, diagnostic comprehensiveness, and evaluation efficiency. In this work, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a holistic and efficient benchmark for evaluating TIR methods, featuring three key advantages. First, it provides diverse task settings, combining widely used mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive QA tasks with two newly designed tasks, namely the tool-grounded experimental design task and the dynamic interactive task, to probe models' abilities in complex tool invocation and multi-tool coordination. Second, TIDE-Bench adopts a comprehensive yet task-aware evaluation protocol, jointly measuring final answer quality, process reliability, tool-use efficiency, and inference cost across heterogeneous task settings. Third, TIDE-Bench constructs high-quality and discriminative evaluation sets by filtering low-discrimination instances from existing datasets, substantially reducing evaluation cost while focusing on more challenging samples. Extensive experiments on multiple foundation models and TIR methods reveal persistent bottlenecks in tool grounding, offering insights for future TIR research.

AI.tldr: TIDE-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型工具集成推理能力的高质量、多样化、高效的综合基准，包含多样化任务设置、全面评估协议和高区分度数据集三大优势。
AI.motivation: 当前工具集成推理领域缺乏高质量、统一的评估基准，现有评估在数据集质量、任务多样性、诊断全面性和评估效率方面存在不足。
AI.method: TIDE-Bench通过三方面构建：1) 多样化任务设置（数学推理、知识密集型QA、工具引导实验设计、动态交互任务）；2) 任务感知的综合评估协议（最终答案质量、过程可靠性、工具使用效率、推理成本）；3) 过滤低区分度实例构建高质量数据集，降低评估成本。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型和TIR方法上的广泛实验揭示了工具接地方面的持续瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: TIDE-Bench为TIR研究提供了更全面、高效的评估工具，揭示了当前模型在工具使用上的关键问题，为未来研究提供了方向。

title: PHAGE: Patent Heterogeneous Attention-Guided Graph Encoder for Representation Learning
summary: Patent claims form a directed dependency structure in which dependent claims inherit and refine the scope of earlier claims; however, existing patent encoders linearize claims as text and discard this hierarchy. Directly encoding this structure into self-attention poses two challenges: claim dependencies mix relation types that differ in semantics and extraction reliability, and the dependency graph is defined over claims while Transformers attend over tokens. PHAGE addresses the first challenge through a deterministic graph construction pipeline that separates near-deterministic legal citations from noisier rule-based technical relations, preserving type distinctions as heterogeneous edges. It addresses the second through a connectivity mask and learnable relation-aware biases that lift claim-level topology into token-level attention, allowing the encoder to differentially weight each relation type. A dual-granularity contrastive objective then aligns representations with both inter-patent taxonomy and intra-patent topology. PHAGE outperforms all baselines on classification, retrieval, and clustering, showing that intra-document claim topology is a stronger inductive bias than inter-document structure and that this bias persists in the encoder weights after training.

AI.tldr: PHAGE通过将专利权利要求的有向依赖结构编码到Transformer注意力中，并设计异构图构建流水线和双粒度对比学习，在分类、检索和聚类任务上超越了所有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有专利编码器将权利要求线性化为文本，丢弃了权利要求之间的有向依赖层级结构，而这种结构蕴含丰富的语义关系。
AI.method: 提出PHAGE方法：(1) 构建确定性图流水线，区分法律引用和技术关系为异构边；(2) 通过连接性掩码和可学习关系偏置，将权利要求级拓扑提升到token级注意力；(3) 设计双粒度对比学习目标，同时对齐跨专利分类体系和专利内拓扑结构。
AI.result: PHAGE在分类、检索和聚类任务上均优于所有基线方法；实验表明文档内权利要求拓扑是比文档间结构更强的归纳偏置，且该偏置在训练后仍保留在编码器权重中。
AI.conclusion: 将专利内部的权利要求依赖结构显式编码到注意力机制中，能够显著提升专利表示的语义质量，且这种结构先验比跨文档关系更具优势。

title: Beyond Thinking: Imagining in 360$^\circ$ for Humanoid Visual Search
summary: Humanoid Visual Search (HVS) requires agents to actively explore immersive 360$^\circ$ environments. While prior methods treat this as a monolithic task relying on cumulative, multi-turn Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, they impose heavy cognitive burdens and require expensive trajectory-level annotations. In this paper, we propose Imagining in 360$^\circ$, a novel framework that decouples the exploration process into a specialized Imaginator and an Actor. The Imaginator functions as a probabilistic predictor of spatial priors; instead of maintaining a cumulative reasoning chain, it infers the semantic layout of both observed and unobserved regions in a single step. By sampling multiple hypotheses within this semantic space, we provide the Actor with a distribution of effective spatial information, offering robust guidance that hedges against uncertainty during active search. This decoupled architecture significantly lowers data engineering costs by eliminating the need for full-trajectory CoT annotations, enabling the generation of over 1.96 million curated training samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that explicitly modeling semantic spatial priors drastically improves search efficiency and success rates in complex, in-the-wild environments.

AI.tldr: 提出Imagining in 360°框架，将人类视觉搜索任务解耦为Imaginator（单步预测语义空间先验）和Actor，无需完整轨迹CoT标注，训练样本超196万，显著提升搜索效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将HVS视为需累积多轮CoT推理的单一任务，认知负担重且需要昂贵的轨迹级标注，亟需更高效解耦的方案。
AI.method: 设计Imaginator与Actor解耦架构：Imaginator单步预测已观测和未观测区域的语义布局，生成多个空间先验假设；Actor基于这些分布信息进行主动搜索，无需完整轨迹CoT标注。
AI.result: 生成196万+训练样本，在复杂野外环境中搜索效率和成功率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模语义空间先验能有效提升复杂环境下的主动搜索性能，且降低数据工程成本。

title: PDEAgent-Bench: A Multi-Metric, Multi-Library Benchmark for PDE Solver Generation
summary: PDE-to-solver code generation aims to automatically synthesize executable numerical solvers from partial differential equation (PDE) specifications. This task requires not only understanding the mathematical structure of PDEs, but also selecting appropriate discretization schemes and solver configurations, and correctly implementing the resulting formulations in finite-element method (FEM) libraries. Existing code generation benchmarks mainly evaluate syntactic correctness, or success on predefined test cases. To our knowledge, there is currently no publicly available benchmark specifically for PDE-to-solver code generation, and general-purpose code benchmarks do not fully capture the unique challenges of numerical PDE solution, such as ensuring solver accuracy, efficiency, and compatibility with professional FEM libraries. We introduce PDEAgent-Bench, to the best of our knowledge, the first multi-metric, multi-library benchmark for PDE-to-solver code generation. PDEAgent-Bench contains 645 instances across 6 mathematical categories and 11 PDE families, with common FEM libraries for DOLFINx, Firedrake, and deal.II. Each instance provides an agent-facing problem specification, a reference solution on a prescribed evaluation grid, and case-specific accuracy and runtime targets. PDEAgent-Bench adopts a staged evaluation framework in which generated solvers must sequentially pass executability, numerical accuracy, and computational efficiency checks. Experiments with representative LLMs and code agents show that models can often produce runnable code, but their pass rate drops substantially once accuracy and efficiency requirements are enforced. These results indicate that current agents remain limited in producing numerically reliable and efficient PDE solvers, and that PDEAgent-Bench provides a reproducible testbed grounded in the practical requirements of numerical PDE solving.

AI.tldr: PDEAgent-Bench是首个面向PDE-to-solver代码生成的多指标、多库基准测试，包含645个实例，实验表明现有LLM和代码代理在生成可运行代码后，在精度和效率要求下通过率大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准主要评估语法正确性或预定义测试用例的通过率，缺乏专门针对PDE-to-solver代码生成的基准，且通用代码基准无法充分捕捉数值PDE求解的独特挑战（如求解器精度、效率及与专业FEM库的兼容性）。
AI.method: 构建包含645个实例、覆盖6个数学类别和11个PDE族的多库基准PDEAgent-Bench，支持DOLFINx、Firedrake和deal.II，采用分阶段评估框架（可执行性→数值精度→计算效率）。
AI.result: 代表性LLM和代码代理能生成可运行代码，但在施加精度和效率要求后通过率大幅下降，表明当前代理在生成数值可靠且高效的PDE求解器方面能力有限。
AI.conclusion: PDEAgent-Bench为数值PDE求解的实际需求提供了一个可复现的测试平台，揭示了当前代码生成模型在数值计算领域的局限性。

title: FERA: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Reasoning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities when guided by high-quality demonstrations, yet such data is often distributed across organizations that cannot centralize it due to regulatory, proprietary, or institutional constraints. We study federated reasoning, where a server improves multi-step reasoning by coordinating with heterogeneous clients holding private demonstrations, without centralized training or raw data sharing. The key challenge is that client reliability is query-dependent, while the server cannot inspect client data to determine which contributions are trustworthy. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Federated Reasoning (FERA), a training-free framework based on iterative server-client co-refinement. Across communication rounds, clients generate reasoning traces with lightweight uncertainty estimates, and the server synthesizes them into improved reasoning that is redistributed as context for the next round, progressively improving both server outputs and client-side reasoning. Within each round, Uncertainty-Aware Self-Critique Aggregation (UA-SCA) resolves conflicts among heterogeneous client traces through query-dependent trust weighting and structured cross-client verification. Rather than simply discarding low-quality traces, UA-SCA revises flawed reasoning steps to recover useful information. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the proposed iterative protocol converges and that uncertainty-aware weighting accelerates convergence. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that FERA consistently outperforms both federated training and training-free baselines, achieving progressively higher accuracy across rounds while maintaining communication and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FERA，一种无需训练的联邦推理框架，通过迭代的服务器-客户端协同精炼和不确定性感知的自批判聚合机制，在保护数据隐私的同时提升多步推理能力，并理论证明其收敛性，实验表明其优于现有联邦训练和无训练基线方法。
AI.motivation: 高质量推理数据常分布在不同机构中，由于监管、产权或制度约束无法集中化。在这些联邦场景下，客户端的可靠性是查询相关的，但服务器无法检查客户端数据以判断哪些贡献可信，因此需要一种无需集中训练或原始数据共享的联邦推理方法。
AI.method: 提出FERA框架，包含：(1) 迭代的服务器-客户端协同精炼机制，跨通信轮次逐步改进推理；(2) 不确定性感知的自批判聚合（UA-SCA），通过查询相关的信任加权和结构化跨客户端验证来解决异构客户端推理轨迹间的冲突，并修正有缺陷的推理步骤而非简单丢弃。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，FERA consistently outperforms both federated training and training-free baselines, achieves progressively higher accuracy across rounds while maintaining communication and computational efficiency. 同时提供了理论保证证明迭代协议收敛，不确定性感知加权能加速收敛。
AI.conclusion: FERA有效解决了联邦场景下客户端可靠性查询依赖且服务器无数据访问权限的挑战，通过轻量级不确定性估计和结构化聚合实现了无需训练的联邦推理，兼顾了性能、隐私和效率。

title: Workspace Optimization: How to Train Your Agent
summary: Modern agents built on frontier language models often cannot adapt their weights. What, then, remains trainable? We argue it is the agent's \emph{workspace}, the structured external substrate it reads, writes, and tests; we call its evolution workspace optimization. Workspace optimization targets hard multi-turn environments where a frontier model has strong priors but cannot solve the task in a single shot, so the agent must learn through interaction. We propose a principled way to evolve the workspace, mirroring the structure of weight-space training: artifacts in place of parameters, evidence in place of data, counterexamples in place of losses, and textual feedback in place of gradients. We instantiate the idea in DreamTeam, a multi-agent harness for ARC-AGI-3 whose roles build an executable world model, plan, hypothesize, probe, strategize, and route failures. On the current 25-game ARC-AGI-3 public set under the official scoring protocol and averaged over two independent runs, DreamTeam improves the SOTA protocol-matched agent's score from 36% to 38.4%, while using 31% fewer environment actions per game.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“工作空间优化”概念，通过演化智能体的外部结构化工作空间（而非权重）来提升性能。DreamTeam实现该思想，在ARC-AGI-3基准上将SOTA从36%提升至38.4%，同时减少31%的环境交互次数。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型构建的智能体通常无法调整权重，因此需要探索在权重不可训练的情况下，哪些组件仍可优化。多轮交互环境中，前沿模型虽有强先验但无法单次解决任务，必须通过交互学习。
AI.method: 提出工作空间优化，以工件替代参数、证据替代数据、反例替代损失、文本反馈替代梯度，形成与权重训练同构的演化过程。DreamTeam是一个多智能体框架，包含执行世界模型、计划、假设、探测、策略和故障路由等角色。
AI.result: 在ARC-AGI-3公开集上，DreamTeam将SOTA协议匹配智能体的分数从36%提升至38.4%，同时每局游戏减少31%的环境操作次数。
AI.conclusion: 工作空间优化是一种可行且高效的学习范式，通过演化外部工作空间而非内部权重，能在多轮交互任务中取得显著提升并降低交互成本。

title: GLiNER-Relex: A Unified Framework for Joint Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction
summary: Joint named entity recognition (NER) and relation extraction (RE) is a fundamental task in natural language processing for constructing knowledge graphs from unstructured text. While recent approaches treat NER and RE as separate tasks requiring distinct models, we introduce GLiNER-Relex, a unified architecture that extends the GLiNER framework to perform both entity recognition and relation extraction in a single model. Our approach leverages a shared bidirectional transformer encoder to jointly represent text, entity type labels, and relation type labels, enabling zero-shot extraction of arbitrary entity and relation types specified at inference time. GLiNER-Relex constructs entity pair representations from recognized spans and scores them against relation type embeddings using a dedicated relation scoring module. We evaluate our model on four standard relation extraction benchmarks: CoNLL04, DocRED, FewRel, and CrossRE, and demonstrate competitive performance against both specialized relation extraction models and large language models, while maintaining the computational efficiency characteristic of the GLiNER family. The model is released as an open-source Python package with a simple inference API that allows users to specify arbitrary entity and relation type labels at inference time and obtain both entities and relation triplets in a single call. All models and code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: GLiNER-Relex 是一个统一的单模型架构，能够同时进行命名实体识别和关系抽取，支持零样本学习，在多个基准测试中表现竞争力强，且计算高效。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将 NER 和 RE 视为独立任务，需要不同的模型来分别处理，缺乏统一的端到端解决方案。作者希望设计一种单一架构，同时完成实体识别和关系抽取，并支持零样本推理。
AI.method: 基于 GLiNER 框架，使用共享的双向 transformer 编码器联合表示文本、实体类型标签和关系类型标签；构建实体对表示并通过专门的关系评分模块与关系类型嵌入进行匹配打分。
AI.result: 在 CoNLL04、DocRED、FewRel 和 CrossRE 四个标准 RE 基准上取得竞争性表现，媲美专用 RE 模型和大语言模型，同时保持了 GLiNER 家族的计算效率优势。
AI.conclusion: GLiNER-Relex 证明了统一的单模型架构可以在 NER 和 RE 联合任务中实现高效且灵活的性能，支持用户自定义实体和关系类型的一次性推理，并已开源发布。

title: Establishing Robust Retinal Eye Tracking: A Weakly Supervised Algorithmic Framework
comment: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (Accepted for Publication)
summary: Retinal image-based eye tracking is widely used in ophthalmic imaging and vision science, and is a promising path to deliver higher gaze accuracy than the pupil- and cornea-based approaches commonly used in modern AR/VR devices. Nevertheless, existing retinal tracking algorithms still primarily rely on classical template-matching registration, which can be insufficiently robust to retinal feature variability and real-world imaging conditions. In this work, we propose a novel weakly-supervised, learning-based framework for robust retinal eye tracking. Initial studies demonstrate high accuracy, achieving the 95th-percentile gaze error < 0.45 deg across a cohort of 6 participants.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于弱监督学习的视网膜眼动追踪框架，在6名参与者中实现了95百分位注视误差<0.45度。
AI.motivation: 现有视网膜眼动追踪算法主要依赖经典模板匹配，对视网膜特征变异和真实成像条件不够鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出了一种弱监督学习框架，用于鲁棒的视网膜眼动追踪。
AI.result: 在6名参与者队列中，95百分位注视误差小于0.45度，精度较高。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督学习框架在视网膜眼动追踪中展现出高精度和鲁棒性，优于传统模板匹配方法。

title: SkillRAE: Agent Skill-Based Context Compilation for Retrieval-Augmented Execution
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents (e.g., OpenClaw) increasingly rely on reusable skill libraries to solve artifact-rich tasks such as document-centric workflows and data-intensive analysis. As these libraries grow, a few works have attempted to study the Retrieval-Augmented Execution (RAE), which often first retrieves some external skills and other knowledge, then compiles the context using retrieved skills, and finally executes the task. Existing works mainly focus on optimizing skill retrieval and task execution, and they pay little attention to how to effectively organize the selected skill evidence in a form that is compact, grounded, and immediately usable for the downstream executors to complete tasks. To fill this gap, we propose SkillRAE, a two-stage RAE approach focusing on skill-based context compilation, which consists of the offline and online stages. Specifically, in the offline indexing stage, it builds a multi-level skill graph over skill communities, skills, and reusable subunits, for capturing their relationships. In the online retrieval stage, it first performs skill-ranked retrieval with selected-subunit evidence export in the graph, and then applies rescue-aware compact compilation to recover the key evidence. Together, these components compile a coarse-ranked skill set into a task-specific context that is compact, grounded, and immediately usable. Experiments on two public benchmarks show that SkillRAE achieves a significant improvement over baselines for RAE. For example, on SkillsBench, it achieves an improvement of 11.7% over the SOTA method. Ablation studies further show that our context compilation is crucial, instead of a mere prompt addition.

AI.tldr: SkillRAE是一种两阶段方法，通过构建多级技能图谱和上下文压缩，显著提升基于LLM的智能体在技能库上的检索增强执行效果，在SkillsBench上比SOTA提升11.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有RAE方法侧重于优化技能检索和任务执行，忽视了如何将检索到的技能证据组织成紧凑、有依据且可直接用于下游执行器的形式。
AI.method: 提出SkillRAE两阶段方法：离线阶段构建包含技能社区、技能和可重用子单元的多级技能图谱；在线阶段先进行技能排序检索并导出子单元证据，再通过救援感知的紧凑压缩恢复关键证据，最终将粗排序的技能集编译成紧凑、有依据、可立即使用的任务特定上下文。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上比SOTA方法提升11.7%；消融实验证明上下文压缩是关键因素，而非简单的提示添加。
AI.conclusion: SkillRAE通过有效的上下文编译策略，填补了RAE领域中对技能证据组织研究的空白，验证了紧凑且有依据的上下文对下游任务执行的重要性。

title: AQMP: Image compression through Adaptive Quadtree Refinement and Matching Pursuit with Hyperparameter Optimization
summary: We present AQMP, a novel image codec combining Adaptive Quadtree Refinement with Matching Pursuit. Unlike conventional Matching Pursuit methods that operate on fixed-size sub-images, AQMP dynamically adapts block sizes to local image structure, allocating finer partitions where the image is complex and coarser ones where it is smooth. This adaptivity yields superior compression ratios compared to fixed-size block Matching Pursuit at equivalent image quality, while offering significant parallelization opportunities at both the tree-leaf level and during compression of individual nodes. The algorithm is governed by user-specified accuracy and sparsity parameters alongside a small set of additional hyperparameters. To navigate the trade-off between compression efficiency and visual quality, we perform multi-objective hyperparameter optimization using the Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator, producing comprehensive Pareto fronts. Experimental results show that AQMP achieves up to $4\times$ higher compression rates than JPEG at comparable SSIM values, while maintaining competitive quality across a broad range of compression regimes. Performance evaluation is provided using a representative set of test images. To ensure reproducibility and promote adoption, we have made our implementation publicly available on GitHub under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合自适应四叉树细化与匹配追踪的新型图像编解码器AQMP，通过动态调整块大小适应图像局部结构，相比固定块匹配追踪实现更优压缩比，且支持并行化。实验表明，在相同SSIM下，压缩率可达JPEG的4倍。
AI.motivation: 传统匹配追踪方法使用固定大小的子图像块，无法根据图像局部复杂度自适应调整，导致压缩效率不足。
AI.method: 采用自适应四叉树细化（Adaptive Quadtree Refinement）结合匹配追踪（Matching Pursuit），根据图像局部结构动态分配块大小；通过Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator进行多目标超参数优化，平衡压缩效率与视觉质量。
AI.result: 在同等SSIM下，AQMP的压缩率可达JPEG的4倍；在多种压缩场景下保持有竞争力的质量。
AI.conclusion: AQMP是一种高效的自适应图像压缩方法，优于传统固定块匹配追踪和JPEG，且实现已开源以促进推广。

title: Absurd World: A Simple Yet Powerful Method to Absurdify the Real-world for Probing LLM Reasoning Capabilities
summary: While extremely powerful and versatile at various tasks, the thinking capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are often put under scrutiny as they sometimes fail to solve problems that humans can systematically solve. However, recent literature focuses on breaking LLM reasoning with increasingly complex problems, and whether an LLM is robust in simple logical reasoning remains underexplored. This paper proposes Absurd World, a benchmarking framework, to test LLMs against altered realism, where scenarios are logically coherent, and humans can easily solve the tasks. Absurd World breaks a real-world model into symbols, actions, sequences, and events, which are automatically altered to create absurd worlds where the logic to solve the tasks remains the same. It evaluates a large collection of models with simple and advanced prompting techniques, and proves that it is an effective tool to determine LLMs' ability to think logically, ignoring the patterns learned from the real world. One can use this framework to extensively test an LLM against a real-world problem to verify whether the LLM's reasoning capability is robust against variations of the task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Absurd World框架，通过构建逻辑一致但与现实不符的荒谬场景，测试大语言模型在简单逻辑推理中的鲁棒性，发现LLM过度依赖现实世界模式而非纯粹逻辑推理。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注LLM在复杂推理任务上的失败，但对其在简单逻辑推理中的鲁棒性关注不足，尤其当任务逻辑不变但场景脱离现实时，LLM是否仍能正确推理尚不明确。
AI.method: 将现实世界模型分解为符号、动作、序列和事件四个要素，通过自动化修改这些要素生成逻辑一致但现实错乱的荒谬世界，保持任务解决逻辑不变，并用多种提示策略评估LLM。
AI.result: 大量模型实验表明，多种提示技术在荒谬世界场景下性能显著下降，验证了LLM倾向于依赖从现实世界学到的模式而非纯粹的逻辑推理。
AI.conclusion: Absurd World是评估LLM逻辑推理鲁棒性的有效工具，可用于检验模型在面对任务变体时是否真正具备稳定的推理能力。

title: Synthetic Pre-Pre-Training Improves Language Model Robustness to Noisy Pre-Training Data
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on web-scale corpora for pre-training. The noise inherent in these datasets tends to obscure meaningful patterns and ultimately degrade model performance. Data curation mitigates but cannot eliminate such noise, so pre-training corpora remain noisy in practice. We therefore study whether a lightweight pre-pre-training (PPT) stage based on synthetic data with learnable temporal structure helps resist noisy data during the pre-training (PT) stage. Across various corruption settings, our method consistently improves robustness to noise during PT, with larger relative gains at higher noise levels. For a 1B-parameter model, a synthetic PPT stage with only 65M tokens achieves the same final loss as the baseline while using up to 49\% fewer natural-text PT tokens across different noise levels. Mechanistic analyses suggest PPT does not immediately suppress attention to noisy tokens. Rather, PPT-initialized models gradually downweight attention between corrupted tokens during noisy PT. This indicates that synthetic PPT inhibits noise self-modeling and shapes the subsequent optimization trajectory. Code is available at https://github.com/guox18/formal-language-prepretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于合成数据与可学习时序结构的轻量级预预训练（PPT）方法，能有效提升大语言模型在预训练阶段对噪声数据的鲁棒性，实验表明在1B参数模型上仅用6500万PPT token即可节省高达49%的自然文本PT token。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练语料中普遍存在噪声，数据清洗无法完全消除这些噪声，导致模型性能下降。作者希望找到一种轻量级方法，在不显著增加训练成本的前提下增强模型对预训练阶段噪声的抵抗能力。
AI.method: 在标准的预训练（PT）阶段之前，引入一个基于合成数据且具有可学习时序结构的预预训练（PPT）阶段。PPT阶段使用形式化语言（formal language）生成的合成数据，让模型先学习清晰、规则化的时序模式，再进入包含噪声的自然文本PT阶段。
AI.result: 在不同噪声设置下，PPT方法一致地提升了模型对噪声的鲁棒性，噪声越大相对收益越明显。1B参数模型仅用6500万PPT token，即可在自然文本PT token上节省高达49%。机制分析表明，PPT初始化的模型在含噪PT中会逐渐降低对噪声token的注意力权重。
AI.conclusion: 合成PPT并非直接抑制对噪声token的注意力，而是通过改变优化轨迹，使模型在后续含噪训练中自然地抑制噪声自建模（noise self-modeling），从而提升最终性能。

title: Unpredictability dissociates from structured control in language agents
summary: Unpredictable behavior is often taken as evidence of control, yet stochastic dispersion and structured action control need not coincide. This paper tests whether stochastic sampling can substitute for structured mechanisms that couple reasons, memory, self-state and inhibition to action selection in a language-agent implementation whose control components can be selectively disabled. In a seven-dataset baseline lesion matrix comprising 74,352 calls, the high-stochasticity comparator was more unpredictable than the structured-control variant in 7/7 datasets, whereas targeted reason and veto lesions reduced the expected structured-control profiles in 7/7 datasets each. In a matched-interface control spanning 26,946 generations, the structured agent maintained stronger action-field coupling than all stochastic, post-hoc, scrambled and verbosity controls across every dataset. The primary behavioral test removed free-form trace wording from the evaluation: 57,816 scored records showed the structured-control variant exceeding the high-stochasticity comparator or the reason/veto lesions in 7/7 datasets for all predefined behavioral components. Later open-weight runs extended the no-context controls to Qwen2.5 7B, 14B and 32B and to an independent Mistral-7B family across 20 task families and three agent scaffolds; no-fields, scrambled-context and distribution-matched controls failed to recover structured action control. A three-annotator blinded audit over 1,200 overlap items preserved high agreement. Strict entropy matching, strict token/compute matching and a formal counterfactual-flip stress test did not meet their gates and are treated as limitations. Stochastic unpredictability did not reproduce structured, action-coupled control in this implemented agent family.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模消融实验证明，随机采样无法替代结构化控制机制（理由、记忆、自我状态和抑制）在语言智能体行动选择中的作用。在多个数据集和模型上，结构化控制变体在行为耦合上始终优于高随机性对照。
AI.motivation: 检验随机采样是否能替代结构化机制（理由、记忆、自我状态、抑制）来实现行动选择中的耦合控制。
AI.method: 在语言智能体实现中，选择性禁用控制组件，构建七数据集基线消融矩阵（74,352次调用），进行匹配接口控制（26,946次生成）、行为测试（57,816条记录）及跨模型验证（Qwen2.5 7B/14B/32B、Mistral-7B系列）。
AI.result: 高随机性比较器在7/7数据集中比结构化控制变体更不可预测；理由和否决消融在7/7数据集中降低了结构化控制轮廓。结构化智能体在所有数据集中保持更强的行动-场耦合。盲审一致性高。严格的熵匹配、token/计算匹配和反事实翻转压力测试未通过。
AI.conclusion: 随机不可预测性无法再现结构化、行动耦合的控制。随机采样不能替代结构化控制机制。

title: NyayaAI: An AI-Powered Legal Assistant Using Multi-Agent Architecture and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Legal information in India remains largely inaccessible due to the complexity of legal language and the sheer volume of legal documentation involved in research and case analysis. This paper presents NyayaAI, an AI-powered legal assistant that automates and simplifies legal workflows for lawyers, law students, and general users. The system combines Large Language Models with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline grounded in a curated Indian legal knowledge base comprising constitutional provisions, statutes, case laws, and judicial precedents. A multi-agent architecture orchestrated through the Mastra TypeScript framework coordinates a main agent with specialized sub-agents handling legal research, document summarization, case law retrieval, and drafting assistance. A compliance module validates all responses before delivery. Domain classification achieved 70\% precision across test samples, with RAG retrieval precision at 74\% and overall response accuracy at 72\%, demonstrating that structured multi-agent LLM systems can meaningfully improve legal accessibility and workflow efficiency. The code\footnote{https://github.com/B97784/NyayaAI} is made publicly available for the benefit of the research community.

AI.tldr: NyayaAI 是一个面向印度法律领域的 AI 助手，结合大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）技术，通过多智能体架构实现法律研究、文档摘要、判例检索和文书起草等功能，在测试中达到了 70%-74% 的准确率，并已开源。
AI.motivation: 印度法律信息因语言复杂且文档数量庞大而难以获取，现有工具难以有效降低法律研究和案例分析的门槛。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLM）结合检索增强生成（RAG）管道，基于印度法律知识库（宪法、成文法、判例、司法先例）；采用 Mastra TypeScript 框架构建多智能体架构，包括主智能体与专门负责法律研究、文档摘要、判例检索和起草辅助的子智能体；并设置了合规性验证模块。
AI.result: 领域分类精度 70%，RAG 检索精度 74%，整体响应准确率 72%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的多智能体大语言模型系统能够有效提升法律信息的可获取性和工作流程效率。

title: Flame3D: Zero-shot Compositional Reasoning of 3D Scenes with Agentic Language Models
summary: 3D scene understanding spans reasoning about free space, object grounding, hypothetical object insertions, complex geometric relationships, and integrating all of these with external tools and data sources. Existing 3D understanding methods typically rely on large-scale 3D-language training or focus on object grounding and simple spatial relationships. We argue that the broad generalization that motivates 3D-language training can be achieved at inference time, without 3D-specific training. We propose Flame3D, a training-free framework that represents scenes as editable visual-textual 3D memories and exposes them to an off-the-shelf MLLM through composable spatial tools. Flame3D also lets the agent synthesize custom spatial programs at inference time, enabling open-ended reasoning over layouts, empty space, and objects not yet present in the scene. External data and corrections can be added to the memory without retraining. In addition to showing competitive performance to finetuned 3D-LMM methods on ScanQA, we study multi-hop 3D reasoning capabilities of Flame3D by evaluating it on a curated compositional spatial-reasoning benchmark, Compose3D. We find that fixed tools fall short and that the agent's ability to synthesize spatial operations at inference time is essential. These results invite the question: should future progress in 3D scene understanding focus on richer scene memories and expressive compositional abstractions?

AI.tldr: Flame3D提出了一种无需3D训练即可实现开放场景理解的框架，通过将场景表示为可编辑的视觉-文本3D记忆，并利用现成MLLM与可组合空间工具进行推理，在推理时合成空间程序来处理布局、空空间和未出现物体等复杂关系。
AI.motivation: 现有3D理解方法依赖大规模3D-语言预训练，或仅聚焦于物体定位和简单空间关系，缺乏对自由空间、假设物体插入、复杂几何关系及外部工具集成的广泛泛化能力。
AI.method: 将场景表示为可编辑的视觉-文本3D记忆，通过可组合空间工具暴露给现成MLLM，并在推理时让智能体合成自定义空间程序，支持开放端推理。
AI.result: 在ScanQA上与微调3D-LMM方法性能相当；在组合空间推理基准Compose3D上验证了推理时合成空间操作的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 未来的3D场景理解应关注更丰富的场景记忆和可组合的抽象表示，而非单纯的3D预训练。

title: Ambig-DS: A Benchmark for Task-Framing Ambiguity in Data-Science Agents
summary: As data-science agents shift from co-pilots to auto-pilots, silent misframing becomes a critical failure mode. Agents quietly commit to plausible but unintended task framings, producing clean, executable artifacts that hide their incorrect assessment of the task. Existing benchmarks score whether the pipeline runs, ignoring whether the agent recognized the task was underspecified. We introduce Ambig-DS, two diagnostic suites: one for prediction-target ambiguity (Ambig-DS-Target, 51 tasks built on DSBench, a tabular modeling benchmark) and one for evaluation-objective ambiguity (Ambig-DS-Objective, 61 tasks built on MLE-bench, a Kaggle-style ML competition benchmark), constructed so that scoring uses each source benchmark's original evaluator. For every task we pair the original, fully specified version with an ambiguous variant produced by controlled edits; a human-and-LLM verification pipeline confirms each variant admits multiple plausible interpretations with decision-relevant consequences. The suites are analyzed independently and ambiguity lowers performance in both. Across five agents spanning efficient to frontier-class models, we find in our controlled diagnostic setting: (i) failures are silent commitments: wrong-target submissions on Target, wrong-metric or non-committal baseline submissions on Objective, rather than execution errors; (ii) allowing the agent to ask one clarifying question recovers much of the loss under idealized conditions, suggesting missing framing information drives a substantial part of the observed degradation; but (iii) agents cannot reliably tell when to use it: permissive prompts induce over-asking on clear tasks, while conservative prompts induce silent defaulting on ambiguous ones. Recognizing target and objective underspecification, not pipeline execution, is the bottleneck missing from standard DS-agent evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ambig-DS基准测试集，发现数据科学智能体的主要失败模式并非执行错误，而是对任务目标（预测目标/评估指标）的沉默性错误框架。智能体在模糊任务中倾向于生成可运行但错误的解决方案，且无法恰当使用澄清机制。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只评估数据科学智能体能否成功执行流程（pipeline是否正常运行），忽视了智能体是否识别出任务定义不明确（underspecified）这一关键问题。当智能体从辅助角色转向自主角色时，沉默性错误框架成为一个关键失败模式。
AI.method: 构建两个诊断套件：Ambig-DS-Target（51个任务，基于DSBench，针对预测目标歧义性）和Ambig-DS-Objective（61个任务，基于MLE-bench，针对评估目标歧义性）。每个任务配对一个完整规范版本和一个受控编辑产生的模糊变体，通过人机验证管道确保每个变体存在多个合理解释。测试5个不同能力的智能体。
AI.result: 三种关键发现：（1）失败源于沉默性承诺（错误目标或错误指标），而非执行错误；（2）允许提问一条澄清信息可大幅恢复性能，说明模糊性信息缺失是性能下降主因；（3）智能体无法可靠判断何时应该提问：宽松提示导致过度提问，保守提示导致在模糊任务上沉默性默认。
AI.conclusion: 识别任务目标和评估指标的模糊性才是数据科学智能体评估中缺失的关键瓶颈，而非流程执行能力。

title: ASTRA-QA: A Benchmark for Abstract Question Answering over Documents
summary: Document-based question answering (QA) increasingly includes abstract questions that require synthesizing scattered information from long documents or across multiple documents into coherent answers. However, this setting is still poorly supported by existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, which often lack stable abstract references or rely on coarse similarity metrics and unstable head-to-head comparisons. To alleviate this issue, we introduce ASTRA-QA, a benchmark for AbSTRAct Question Answering over documents. ASTRA-QA contains 869 QA instances over academic papers and news documents, covering five abstract question types and three controlled retrieval scopes. Each instance is equipped with explicit evaluation annotations, including answer topic sets, curated unsupported topics, and aligned evidence. Building on these annotations, ASTRA-QA assesses whether answers cover required key points and avoid unsupported content by directly scoring topic coverage and curated unsupported content, enabling scalable evaluation without exhaustive head-to-head comparisons. Experiments with representative Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods spanning vanilla, graph-based, and hierarchical retrieval settings show that ASTRA-QA provides reference-grounded diagnostics for coverage, hallucination, and retrieval-scope robustness. Our dataset and code are available at https://xinyangsally.github.io/astra-benchmark.

AI.tldr: ASTRA-QA是一个面向文档的抽象问答基准，包含869个问答实例和明确的评估标注，用于评估答案是否覆盖关键要点并避免无关内容，支持可扩展的评测。
AI.motivation: 现有基准和评估方法缺乏稳定的抽象参考，依赖粗糙的相似度指标和不稳定的两两对比，无法有效支持需要综合分散信息的抽象问答场景。
AI.method: 构建包含869个问答实例的基准，覆盖5种抽象问题类型和3种检索范围，配备答案主题集、策划的无关主题和对齐证据等标注，通过直接评分主题覆盖度和无关内容来实现可扩展评估。
AI.result: 实验表明ASTRA-QA能够为RAG方法（包括普通检索、图检索和分层检索）提供基于参考的诊断，评估覆盖率、幻觉和检索范围鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA-QA有效解决了抽象问答中缺乏稳定参考和评估困难的问题，为抽象问答提供了可扩展、可诊断的评测框架。

title: CATS: Curvature Aware Temporal Selection for efficient long video understanding
summary: Understanding long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires selecting a small subset of informative frames under strict computational budgets, where exhaustive processing is infeasible and optimal selection is combinatorial. We propose CATS, a curvature-aware frame selection method that explicitly models the temporal geometry of query-frame relevance to identify salient events and their surrounding context. By leveraging temporal curvature to adapt selection density, CATS captures both abrupt transitions and gradually evolving content while suppressing redundant frames. Under a fixed backbone and frame budget, CATS consistently outperforms prior lightweight approaches such as AKS on LongVideoBench and VideoMME. While multi-stage methods such as MIRA achieve higher absolute accuracy, they incur substantial computational overhead; in contrast, CATS retains approximately 93-95% of MIRA's performance while requiring only 3-4% of its preprocessing cost, yielding a favorable efficiency-accuracy trade-off. Beyond answer accuracy, we evaluate description generation using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and the obtained results show that CATS produces more coherent and informative outputs, indicating improved grounding in visual evidence. These results position CATS as a computationally efficient and principled approach to long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: CATS是一种曲率感知的帧选择方法，通过显式建模查询-帧相关性的时间几何结构，在固定计算预算下高效识别长视频中的关键帧，以极低的预处理成本达到接近多阶段方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解中，多模态大模型需要在有限计算预算下从海量帧中选取信息量最大的子集，穷举处理不可行，最优选择具有组合爆炸性质。
AI.method: 利用时间曲率（temporal curvature）显式建模查询-帧相关性的时间几何结构，自适应调整选择密度，捕获突变事件和渐进变化，同时抑制冗余帧。
AI.result: 在LongVideoBench和VideoMME上持续优于AKS等轻量方法；保持MIRA约93-95%的性能，但预处理成本仅为MIRA的3-4%；在描述生成任务中产生更连贯和信息量更大的输出。
AI.conclusion: CATS提供了一种计算高效且原理化的长视频理解方案，在精度与效率之间取得了有利的权衡。

title: When Reviews Disagree: Fine-Grained Contradiction Analysis in Scientific Peer Reviews
summary: Scientific peer reviews frequently contain conflicting expert judgments, and the increasing scale of conference submissions makes it challenging for Area Chairs and editors to reliably identify and interpret such disagreements. Existing approaches typically frame reviewer disagreement as binary contradiction detection over isolated sentence pairs, abstracting away the review-level context and obscuring differences in the severity of evaluative conflict. In this work, we introduce a fine-grained formulation of reviewer contradiction analysis that operates over full peer reviews by explicitly identifying contradiction evidence spans and assigning graded disagreement intensity scores. To support this task, we present RevCI, an expert-annotated benchmark of peer-review pairs with evidence-level contradiction annotations with graded intensity labels. We further propose IMPACT, a structured multi-agent framework that integrates aspect-conditioned evidence extraction, deliberative reasoning, and adjudication to model reviewer contradictions and their intensity. To support efficient deployment, we distill IMPACT into TIDE, a small language model that predicts contradiction evidence and intensity in a single forward pass. Experimental results show that IMPACT substantially outperforms strong single-agent and generic multi-agent baselines in both evidence identification and intensity agreement, while TIDE achieves competitive performance at significantly lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种细粒度的审稿矛盾分析方法，通过识别矛盾证据片段和分配分级强度分数来建模同行评审中的审稿人分歧，并构建了专家标注基准RevCI、多智能体框架IMPACT及其蒸馏版本TIDE。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将审稿人分歧简化为孤立句子对的二元矛盾检测，忽略了评审上下文和分歧严重程度的差异，导致领域主席和编辑难以可靠地识别和解释评审中的冲突意见。
AI.method: 提出了IMPACT：一个结构化多智能体框架，包含方面条件证据提取、深思熟虑推理和裁决机制；同时蒸馏出TIDE：一个小型语言模型，可通过单次前向传播预测矛盾证据和强度。还构建了RevCI专家标注基准。
AI.result: IMPACT在证据识别和强度一致性上显著优于强单智能体和通用多智能体基线；TIDE在推理成本大幅降低的情况下取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的矛盾分析（识别证据片段+分级强度）比二元矛盾检测更有效，且多智能体框架与蒸馏策略在性能与效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Primal-Dual Guided Decoding for Constrained Discrete Diffusion
summary: Discrete diffusion models generate structured sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but enforcing global property constraints during generation remains an open challenge. We propose primal-dual guided decoding, an inference-time method that formulates constrained generation as a KL-regularised optimisation problem and solves it online via adaptive Lagrangian multipliers. At each denoising step, the method modifies token logits through an additive, constraint-dependent bias, with multipliers updated by mirror descent based on constraint violation. The bias arises as the optimal KL-regularised projection of the constraint, so the constrained distribution remains as close as possible to the model's unconstrained distribution while still satisfying the constraint. The method requires no retraining and no additional model evaluations beyond standard sampling, supports multiple simultaneous constraints, and provides formal bounds on constraint violation. We evaluate our approach on topical text generation, molecular design, and music playlist generation, showing that a single algorithm instantiated via domain-specific scoring functions improves constraint satisfaction while preserving relevant domain-specific quality metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重训练的自适应引导解码方法，通过在离散扩散模型的去噪过程中在线调整拉格朗日乘子，将全局属性约束转化为对令牌logits的修正，在保持生成质量的同时满足约束。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型在生成结构化序列时难以强制满足全局属性约束，现有方法通常需要重训练或额外的模型评估，效率低下。
AI.method: 将约束生成问题形式化为KL正则化优化问题，通过原始-对偶引导解码在推理时自适应调整拉格朗日乘子，用镜像下降更新乘子，将对约束的KL正则化投影作为偏置项修改令牌logits。
AI.result: 在主题文本生成、分子设计和音乐播放列表生成三个任务上，该方法在满足约束的同时保持了领域特定的生成质量指标。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需重训练和额外模型评估，支持多约束，且具有约束违反的形式化边界，是一种通用有效的约束生成框架。

title: LegalCiteBench: Evaluating Citation Reliability in Legal Language Models
comment: Preprint. 23 pages including references and appendices
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into legal drafting and research workflows, where incorrect citations or fabricated precedents can cause serious professional harm. Existing legal benchmarks largely emphasize statutory reasoning, contract understanding, or general legal question answering, but they do not directly study a central common-law failure mode: when asked to provide case authorities without external grounding, models may return plausible-looking but incorrect citations or cases. We introduce LegalCiteBench, a benchmark for studying closed-book citation recovery, citation verification, and case matching in legal language models. LegalCiteBench contains approximately 24K evaluation instances constructed from 1,000 real U.S. judicial opinions from the Case Law Access Project. The benchmark covers five citation-centric tasks: citation retrieval, citation completion, citation error detection, case matching, and case verification and correction. Across 21 LLMs, exact citation recovery remains highly challenging in this closed-book setting: even the strongest models score below 7/100 on citation retrieval and completion. Within the evaluated models, scale and legal-domain pretraining provide limited gains and do not resolve this difficulty. Models also frequently provide concrete but incorrect or low-overlap authorities under our evaluation protocol, with Misleading Answer Rates (MAR) exceeding 94% for 20 of 21 evaluated models on retrieval-heavy tasks. A prompt-only abstention experiment shows that explicit uncertainty instructions reduce some confident fabrication but do not improve citation correctness. LegalCiteBench is intended as a diagnostic framework for studying authority generation failures, verification behavior, and abstention when external grounding is absent, incomplete, or bypassed.

AI.tldr: LegalCiteBench是一个包含约24K个测试样本的法律引用基准，用于评估大语言模型在封闭式设置下生成、验证和匹配法律判例的能力。实验发现，即使最强模型在引用检索和补全任务上得分低于7/100，且21个模型中有20个的误导回答率超过94%，规模扩大和法律领域预训练带来的改进有限。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准主要关注法条推理、合同理解或一般性法律问答，但缺乏对法律大模型的一个核心失败模式——即当模型在没有外部知识支持的情况下被要求提供判例权威时，可能生成看起来合理但实际错误的引用或案例——的系统性研究。
AI.method: 从Case Law Access Project中选取1,000份真实的美国司法意见，构建约24K个评估实例，涵盖五个引用核心任务：引用检索、引用补全、引用错误检测、案例匹配、案例验证与纠正。对21个LLM进行封闭式评估，并设计了提示词层面的弃权实验。
AI.result: 最强的封闭式引用检索和补全得分低于7/100；20/21的模型在检索密集任务上误导回答率超过94%；规模扩大和法律领域预训练带来的提升有限；明确的弃权指令能减少部分自信编造，但无法提升引用正确性。
AI.conclusion: LegalCiteBench可作为诊断框架，用于研究法律语言模型在缺乏外部知识时的权威生成失败、验证行为和弃权机制，揭示了当前LLM在法律引用任务上存在严重且未解决的局限性。

title: Towards Robust Sequential Decomposition for Complex Image Editing
summary: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-fidelity image editing guided by human instructions. However, these models often struggle with complex instructions involving combinatorial editing operations or inter-step dependencies. This difficulty stems from the limitations of two canonical paradigms: (1) single-turn editing, which attempts to apply all instructed edits in one pass, often fails to parse the complex instruction accurately and causes undesired edits; and (2) sequential editing can decompose the task into simpler steps but suffers from compounding errors introduced by the sequential execution, leading to low-fidelity results. To derive a robust solution for complex image editing, we examine editing behaviors of different paradigms under a unified in-context editing framework, and study how the benefits of sequential decomposition can be balanced against its error-accumulation drawbacks. We further develop a synthetic data pipeline that constructs editing tasks of varying instruction complexity, allowing us to curate a large-scale editing dataset with high-quality decomposed sequences. By finetuning on synthetic data, we discovered that with properly designed editing paradigms, sequential decomposition yields robust improvements even as task complexity increases. Furthermore, the decomposition skills learned from synthetic tasks can transfer to real images by co-training with real-world editing data, demonstrating the promise of sim-to-real generalization for tackling complex image editing across broader domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了复杂图像编辑中两种范式（单轮编辑和顺序编辑）的不足，提出了一种统一上下文编辑框架，通过合成数据pipeline构建高质量分解序列数据集，发现顺序分解结合精心设计的编辑范式能有效提升鲁棒性，且分解技能可从合成任务迁移到真实图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成模型在处理包含组合编辑操作或步骤间依赖的复杂指令时表现不佳，单轮编辑无法准确解析复杂指令，顺序编辑则因累积错误导致保真度低。作者旨在探索如何平衡顺序分解的优势与误差累积问题，从而提出鲁棒的复杂图像编辑方案。
AI.method: 在统一上下文编辑框架下比较不同范式的编辑行为；设计合成数据pipeline构建不同指令复杂度的编辑任务，并生成高质量分解序列数据集；通过微调模型在合成数据上学习分解技能，并结合真实编辑数据协同训练实现跨域迁移。
AI.result: 经适当设计的编辑范式下，顺序分解即使在任务复杂度增加时也能带来鲁棒性提升；从合成任务学到的分解技能可迁移到真实图像编辑任务中。
AI.conclusion: 顺序分解结合精心设计的范式是应对复杂图像编辑的有效策略，合成到真实的泛化方法为更广泛的图像编辑应用提供了可行路径。

title: How Should LLMs Listen While Speaking? A Study of User-Stream Routing in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue requires a model to keep listening while generating its own spoken response. This is challenging for large language models (LLMs), which are designed to extend a single coherent sequence and do not naturally support user input arriving during generation. We argue that how the user stream is routed into the LLM is therefore a key architectural question for full-duplex modeling. To study this question, we extend a text-only LLM into a unified full-duplex spoken dialogue system and compare two routing strategies under a shared training pipeline: (i) channel fusion, which injects the user stream directly into the LLM input, and (ii) cross-attention routing, which keeps the user stream as external memory accessed through cross-attention adapters. Experiments on spoken question answering and full-duplex interaction benchmarks reveal a clear tradeoff. Channel fusion yields stronger semantic grounding and consistently better question-answering performance. However, under semantically overlapping conditions such as user interruptions, it is more vulnerable to context corruption: if the model fails to stop in time, the overlapping user stream can interfere with ongoing generation and lead to semantically incoherent continuations. Cross-attention routing underperforms on question answering, but better preserves the LLM generation context and is more robust to this failure mode. These results establish user-stream routing as a central design axis in full-duplex spoken dialogue and offer practical guidance on the tradeoff between semantic integration and context robustness. We provide a demo page for qualitative inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全双工语音对话系统中用户输入流路由策略（通道融合 vs 交叉注意力路由）对模型性能的影响，发现两者在语义理解与上下文鲁棒性之间存在明确权衡。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音对话要求模型在生成自身语音回复的同时持续监听用户输入，但传统LLM设计为生成单一连贯序列，难以自然支持生成过程中用户输入的到达。因此，如何将用户流路由到LLM中是一个关键的架构问题。
AI.method: 将文本LLM扩展为统一的全双工语音对话系统，比较两种路由策略：（i）通道融合——直接将用户流注入LLM输入；（ii）交叉注意力路由——将用户流作为外部记忆，通过交叉注意力适配器访问。在相同训练流程下进行对比实验。
AI.result: 通道融合在语义理解和问答性能上更优，但在用户打断等语义重叠条件下更容易发生上下文干扰，导致生成不连贯；交叉注意力路由在问答任务上表现较弱，但能更好保持生成上下文，对此类失败模式更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 用户流路由策略是全双工语音对话的核心设计轴，需要在语义集成与上下文鲁棒性之间进行权衡，为实际系统设计提供了指导。

title: CalibFree: Self-Supervised View Feature Separation for Calibration-Free Multi-Camera Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Multi-camera multi-object tracking (MCMOT) faces significant challenges in maintaining consistent object identities across varying camera perspectives, particularly when precise calibration and extensive annotations are required. In this paper, we present CalibFree, a self-supervised representation learning framework that does not need any calibration or manual labeling for the MCMOT task. By promoting feature separation between view-agnostic and view-specific representations through single-view distillation and cross-view reconstruction, our method adapts to complex, dynamic scenarios with minimal overhead.
